restaurant.name: The Curry House
restaurant.info: The Curry House is a fictional demo restaurant serving North and South Indian dishes at Musterstraße 1, 10115 Berlin. Most curries are cooked to order, and the spice level of many dishes can be adjusted on request.

items.name: Vegetable Samosa
items.description: Two crisp pastries filled with spiced potato and green peas, served with tamarind chutney.

items.name: Onion Bhaji
items.description: Onion fritters in a light chickpea-flour batter with cumin and fresh coriander.

items.name: Paneer Tikka

items.name: Chicken Tikka Starter

items.name: Tandoori Prawns

items.name: Papadum Basket

items.name: Lamb Seekh Kebab

items.name: Chicken Tikka Masala

items.name: Butter Chicken

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Tuesday to Sunday from 12:00 to 15:00 and from 17:30 to 22:30. We are closed on Mondays.

faqs.question: Do you deliver?
faqs.answer: Yes, we deliver within 5 km of the restaurant from 17:30 to 22:00. The minimum order is 20 EUR and delivery is free above 35 EUR, otherwise 2.50 EUR.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, EC/girocard, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Orders placed online can also be paid with PayPal.

faqs.question: Can I make a reservation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reservations can be made by phone or through the reservation link on our menu page. Tables are held for 15 minutes past the booking time.

faqs.question: Do you offer takeaway?
faqs.answer: Yes, every dish on the menu is available for pickup. Order at the counter or online and collect it about 20 minutes later.

faqs.question: Can you cater for groups or events?
faqs.answer: We host groups of up to 40 guests and offer set menus from 29 EUR per person. Please contact us at least one week in advance.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee a dish is completely free of an allergen?
faqs.answer: Our kitchen handles nuts, gluten, milk and other allergens, so we cannot rule out traces. Please tell our staff about any allergy before ordering.

faqs.question: Do you have high chairs and children's portions?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have high chairs, and most curries can be ordered as a smaller children's portion for 60 percent of the price.
